paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Abba; see R. Yehudah ben Abba among the tannaim. Menachot 31b: “Rav said.” I have not found him speaking in Rav's name. [At the checked locus, Rav Yehudah bar Abba asks an unanswered question about spacing in a scroll.] Rif, Minor Laws, Laws of Torah Scrolls, has Rav Yehudah bar Adda. I likewise have not found a R. Yehudah bar Adda in the Talmud, only bar Idi.
